webster.text: To release from slavery; to liberate from personal bondage or servitude; to free, as a slave.

example.quote: If we must manumit our slaves, what country shall we send them to ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. GALLOWAY, July 26, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
